title: Pimm's Cup
description: Try this Pimm's cup cocktail recipe for a British summer sipper. Known in the UK as Pimm's and lemonade or just Pimm's, you'll love this proper recipe.
ingredients: 1 red apple, cored and thinly sliced

steps.text: Stir Sprite and Pimm's together in a serving pitcher until well mixed; add apple, orange, cucumber wedge, lemon, lime, strawberries, and mint. Serve in ice-filled tall glasses.

video.description: In this video, Nicole shows you how to make Allrecipes’s top rated recipe for Pimm’s cup, which uses Pimm’s and Sprite for the base of the drink. This British recipe is easy-to-make and any beginner can do it. After pouring and mixing both the Pimm’s and Sprite into a cup, add your choices of fruit slices, as well as a cucumber, for a refreshing drink that will definitely cool you off on a hot summer’s day.
video.name: How to Make a Pimm’s Cup
